selection_policy.scope: Candy/confection products with Candy Wrapper Archive lineage leads.
selection_policy.primary_visual_rule: Capture ingredient or nutrition panels when visible; wrapper-front photos remain package-lineage context.
selection_policy.source_priority_rule: Candy Wrapper Archive pages are reviewed before broad web hunting for confection products.
selection_policy.compatible_with: scripts/build-spark-ocr-packets.js, scripts/capture-ingredient-ocr-assets.js, and the native OCR image-map template.

first_rows.ocr_recommended_action: Open the collection page, choose item-level wrapper records by decade, then create source-attributable capture rows for those item pages.
